title: 2 Chronicles 17: Jehoshaphat Sends Teachers Through the Cities
body:
Read the chapter → [2 Chronicles 17](/bible/2-chronicles/17)

This session opens the reign of Jehoshaphat, who strengthened himself, walked in the first ways of his father David, and sent Levites and princes out through the cities of Judah with the book of the Law to teach the people. The pattern is the same one we keep today: wisdom cries out in the streets, the fear of the Most High falls on the nations round about, and wisdom proves better than weapons of war. The teaching moves into chapter 18, where Jehoshaphat joins with Ahab and calls for a true prophet of the Most High rather than the four hundred who only tell the king what he wants to hear.

**[2 Chronicles 17:1](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v1)**
> <sup>[1](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v1)</sup> And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

- Jehoshaphat reigned in the place of his father Asa, taking the throne after him.
- He strengthened himself against Israel, setting himself apart from the northern kingdom's ways.
  - **[1 Kings 15:24](/bible/1-kings/15#v24)**
    > <sup>[24](/bible/1-kings/15#v24)</sup> And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

    Asa slept with his fathers and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

**[2 Chronicles 17:2](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v2)**
> <sup>[2](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v2)</sup> And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

- He placed forces and garrisons in the fenced cities of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa had taken.
- A diligent king secures the land and prepares before trouble comes.

**[2 Chronicles 17:3](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v3)**
> <sup>[3](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v3)</sup> And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

- The Most High was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the first ways of his father David and sought not unto Baal.
- David was a man after the Most High's own heart because he kept the commandments and charged Solomon to keep them.

**[2 Chronicles 17:4](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v4)**
> <sup>[4](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v4)</sup> But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

- Jehoshaphat sought the Lord God of his fathers and walked in his commandments, not after the doings of Israel.
- The way we must walk is defined by the ordinances and laws we are taught.
  - **[Exodus 18:20](/bible/exodus/18#v20)**
    > <sup>[20](/bible/exodus/18#v20)</sup> And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

    Teach them the ordinances and laws and show them the way wherein they must walk.

**[2 Chronicles 17:5](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v5)**
> <sup>[5](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v5)</sup> Therefore the Lord stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

- Because he obeyed, the Most High established the kingdom in his hand.
- All Judah brought presents, and he had riches, honor, and abundance.

**[2 Chronicles 17:6](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v6)**
> <sup>[6](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v6)</sup> And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

- His heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord, not in pride but in devotion.
- He removed the high places and the groves out of Judah, tearing down false worship.

**[2 Chronicles 17:7-9](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v7)**
> <sup>[7](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v7)</sup> Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben–hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v8)</sup> And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob–adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v9)</sup> And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

- In the third year of his reign he sent princes and Levites to teach in the cities of Judah, and they carried the book of the Law of the Lord with them.
- They went throughout all the cities and taught the people, the same pattern we follow, going out into the streets to teach.
  - **[Luke 14:23](/bible/luke/14#v23)**
    > <sup>[23](/bible/luke/14#v23)</sup> And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

    Go out into the highways and hedges and compel them to come in.
  - **[Proverbs 8:1](/bible/proverbs/8#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/proverbs/8#v1)</sup> Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

    Doth not wisdom cry and understanding put forth her voice.
  - **[Proverbs 8:2-3](/bible/proverbs/8#v2)**
    > <sup>[2](/bible/proverbs/8#v2)</sup> She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
    >
    > <sup>[3](/bible/proverbs/8#v3)</sup> She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

    She standeth in the high places, at the gates, at the entry of the city.
  - **[Proverbs 8:4](/bible/proverbs/8#v4)**
    > <sup>[4](/bible/proverbs/8#v4)</sup> Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

    Wisdom's call is unto men and her voice to the sons of men, a rally cry for men.

**[2 Chronicles 17:10](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v10)**
> <sup>[10](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v10)</sup> And the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

- The fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms round about Judah so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
- Teaching the Law had a real effect on the nations; wisdom disarmed his enemies.
  - **[Ecclesiastes 7:19](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v19)**
    > <sup>[19](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v19)</sup> Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.

    Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men in the city.
  - **[Ecclesiastes 9:18](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v18)**
    > <sup>[18](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v18)</sup> Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.

    Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroyeth much good.
  - **[Ecclesiastes 9:14-15](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v14)**
    > <sup>[14](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v14)</sup> There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
    >
    > <sup>[15](/bible/ecclesiastes/9#v15)</sup> Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

    A poor wise man by his wisdom delivered a little city besieged by a great king.

**[2 Chronicles 17:11](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v11)**
> <sup>[11](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v11)</sup> Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

- Some of the Philistines brought presents and tribute silver, and the Arabians brought him flocks of rams and he goats.
- His obedience brought increase even from surrounding peoples.

**[2 Chronicles 17:12-13](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v12)**
> <sup>[12](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v12)</sup> And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v13)</sup> And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

- Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly and built castles and cities of store in Judah.
- Cities of store are cities of provision, like Egypt's storehouses under Joseph in the years of plenty; in captivity our people had neither building nor closet, but the diligent tend to plenty.

**[2 Chronicles 17:14-19](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v14)**
> <sup>[14](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v14)</sup> And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v15)</sup> And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v16)</sup> And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the Lord; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v17)</sup> And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v18)</sup> And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/2-chronicles/17#v19)</sup> These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

- He had much business in the cities of Judah, and mighty men of valor were mustered in Jerusalem by the house of their fathers.
- The captains numbered hundreds of thousands of ready men, prepared for war, waiting on the king beside those set in the fenced cities.
